title: Serve the notes routes from GraphQL Yoga
prompt: The team serves GraphQL with GraphQL Yoga. Create src/graphql.ts exporting `yoga`, made with createYoga from graphql-yoga, whose schema has the query fields `notes` (the listNotes route) and `note` (the getNote route) and the mutation field `createNote` (the createNote route) from src/routes/notes.ts. Do not write resolvers: use Inferlo's GraphQL integration so each field runs its route as the caller of the request (the Authorization header), with the app exported from src/app.ts.
